An invitation from William

Come Build a Hero With Me

Jasper, I made this so you can discover a D&D character through the things you already enjoy: closing the distance, hitting hard, finding an opening, building a loadout, exploring strange places, and choosing an elf when an elf feels right.

This is not a test and no result is an assignment. The quiz gives you a shortlist, the catalogs show every option in the supplied guide, and the final choice remains yours.

From video games to tabletop

The whole game before the details

D&D is closer to choosing an action in an open-ended RPG than memorizing a button rotation. Describe what you want to do; the DM tells you when a rule or die is needed.

Character creation as a loadout: class is the main gameplay kit; species/race is identity and innate traits; background is the former life and starting package; abilities are broad capabilities; skills are trained specialties; equipment is the starting loadout; personality explains why the build belongs to this person.
Personality and playstyle routing

Find the character path that sounds like you

Every question maps to class rhythm, subclass identity, and species traits. The deep route uses all 27 rewritten fantasy dilemmas inspired by the discarded quiz structure, followed by routed tie-breakers.
